decisions.reason: Post-pandemic demand for flexible, height-adjustable workplaces strengthens the value of this multi-model desk line, so the option remains worth holding at modest cost.
The chair family shares the core production base and costs little to maintain, and chairs remain a staple of both the residential and the office ranges.
The carpet-based floor cushions are a niche accessory whose value is still modest, but they reuse rug materials at low holding cost, so they are kept while their contribution is watched.
The sofa had only weak website emphasis from the start, which raises the risk of a quiet phase-out, but it sits close to the core upholstery business and remains cheap to keep.
The high standing table complements the conference and office range at low incremental cost, though the shift to hybrid work leaves its value somewhat uncertain.
The rug collection is a strategic flagship whose growth value is still resolving, and it feeds the cushion line, so keeping this option open is justified despite its distance from the core offer.
